blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. x times the quantity x plus three, minus two times the quantity x squared minus four x, plus five x.
Distribute first. x times x plus three is x squared plus three x. Negative two times x squared minus four x is negative two x squared plus eight x, since negative times negative is positive.
Now combine like terms. x squared minus two x squared is negative x squared. Three x plus eight x plus five x is sixteen x.
So the answer is negative x squared plus sixteen x.

Watch out for these traps. If you make negative two times negative four x negative, you get negative x squared. If you turn negative two x squared into positive, you get three x squared plus sixteen x.
